item_short_desc: Rothco’s Elastic Ankle Holster is an essential duty gear item for law enforcement officers.
description: Rothco’s Elastic Ankle Holster is an essential duty gear item for law enforcement officers. This ankle holster is built to fit sub compact and pocket pistols discretely, which is ideal for deep concealed carry.  Our holster measures 14" x 5" with hook and loop closure, aiming to fit snug and secure around your ankle. This ankle pistol holster features a 1" plastic clip, allowing you to attach a shirt stay and webbing with a hook and loop retention strap for concealed carry. Rothco’s elastic ankle holster is also designed with sheep wool padding for unparalleled comfort.
